[[File:Buffy the Vampire Slayer CCG logo.png|thumb|Original Buffy the Vampire Slayer CCG game logo.]]
The '''Buffy the Vampire Slayer Collectible Card Game''' is set in Sunnydale. Players assemble characters and pursue victory through challenges, fights or control of the Park. [[TCGMix]] offers a browser playtest.<ref name="catalog" />

== History ==

Score released ''Pergamum Prophecy'' in December 2001. ''Angel’s Curse'' and ''Class of ’99'' followed in 2002. The latter went on sale in the United States on 18 November 2002 and was the final set after the game’s cancellation was reported in April 2003.<ref name="bufcatalog" /><ref name="bufnews" /> The ''Class of ’99'' rulebook credits Chaz Elliott, Geert Van Slambrouck, David Eckhard, Christian Moore and Owen Seyler for game design. Before launch, trade coverage identified Moore and Seyler as the lead designers.<ref name="bufrules" /><ref name="bufdesign" />

== Online play ==

Players can [https://tcgmix.com/buffy/ open the game on TCGMix].<ref name="tcgmix-play-buffy-the-vampire-slayer-ccg">[https://tcgmix.com/buffy/ Play Buffy the Vampire Slayer CCG], TCGMix. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261107194237/https://tcgmix.com/buffy/ Internet Archive].</ref>
